changelog:
### New Feature - DNS and MX Verification
- Verify DNS button per domain row in Admin - Domains
- Verify All DNS button to check all domains at once
- 5 checks per domain: MX Record, MX Host Resolves, A Record, SPF TXT, DMARC TXT
- Inline result panel shows pass/warn/fail per check
- Health status and MX record saved to DB and updated in table
- Last Checked column added to domains table
- DNS Configuration Guide added to domains page
